prompt: Collapsing the sidebar on the board freezes the page for a moment. The profiler shows hundreds of small components rendering.

truth.summary: FeatureFlagsProvider builds its context value inline ({ flags, isEnabled }) on every render. AppShell re-renders on UI state changes, so every FeatureGate and PriorityPicker on 420 board cards re-renders.

referenceAnswer.cause: The provider creates a new { flags, isEnabled } value object on every render, so every consumer re-renders when AppShell renders.

decoyAnswers.cause: BoardCard is memoized, so this cannot be a context problem.
AppShell subscribes to too much UI state.

referenceFix.find: import { createContext, type ReactNode, useContext } from 'react'
referenceFix.replace: import { createContext, type ReactNode, useContext, useMemo } from 'react'

referenceFix.find: const value = { flags, isEnabled: (name: string) => flags[name] === true }
referenceFix.replace: const value = useMemo(() => ({ flags, isEnabled: (name: string) => flags[name] === true }), [flags])

genieEvidence.notes: react_get_renders attributes each FeatureGate render to context (exact, 'Context[0]'), and the full view's deep diff isolates /isEnabled as the changed field. The context has no displayName, so it is reported only as Context[0].
